$comment: Reviewed exceptions for scripts/lint_migrations.py. Each entry names one migration, the rules it may break, the issue that needs it, who reviewed it, and the SHA-256 of the reviewed file, so any later edit needs a new review. See docs/development.md#migrations.

entries.reason: Annotates each presentation row with its definition version and records a definition_migration_journal row; it adds columns and a journal and deletes no row. Touched rows and dispositions are in the manifest.

Quarantines pre-existing cross-owner relation rows: moves a row whose required or cascading relation crosses accounts, with its cascade dependents, into relation_quarantine (copied first as raw column text, deleted leaf-first), and clears and journals an offending optional reference or a reference to a moved row, moving the row instead when clearing it would break a unique index, so every retained relation points at a same-owner target. The disposition per relation field is in the manifest.
